title: New Rapid below Phantom Ranch - Sep 8, 2026 (55521141985)
description:
Video taken September 8, 2026, from just downstream of the Black Bridge in Grand Canyon National Park. Debris flows from the August 29 flash flood through Bright Angel Creek have created a new rapid immediately downstream of the Bright Angel Creek confluence.
River runners should be aware that river hydraulics have changed as a result of the August 29 event. Boaters should scout ahead of time and use appropriate caution when approaching this area. Scouting is authorized in this location; however, the Phantom Ranch area remains closed to the public until further notice because of safety concerns and ongoing construction and stabilization work.

The audio features the powerful, continuous sound of a roaring river and rushing water near the newly formed rapid downstream of the Bright Angel Creek confluence. No narration is provided.
